findings.source: Потом его заделали… но только с той стороны.
findings.currentTarget: Apoi l-au zidit… dar numai pe partea cealaltă.
findings.reason: The preceding line calls the object “o fereastră”; Romanian “l-au” is masculine and cannot refer back to this feminine noun. The window was then sealed on the other side.
